import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    data_df = pd.DataFrame(data)

    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    normalized_data = scaler.fit_transform(data_df)

    df = pd.DataFrame(normalized_data, columns=data_df.columns, index=data_df.index)
    df["Average"] = df.mean(axis=1)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    df["Average"].plot(kind="bar", ax=ax)
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_title("Average of Normalized Rows")

    return df, ax
